text: Roadquest has been our go-to hauler for shipments from Bulacan to Cebu. Their trailer trucks arrive on time every time, and their team keeps us updated at every checkpoint. Reliable partner for our retail distribution.

We switched to Roadquest for our port container hauling and never looked back. Their rates are competitive and our cargo always arrives intact. Highly recommended for manufacturers dealing with imports.

As an SME, logistics costs used to eat into our margins. Roadquest's flexible pricing and consistent service helped us scale our provincial deliveries without overspending. Truly a partner, not just a vendor.
Their wing van service is a game-changer for our factory loadouts. Loading is fast, the drivers are professional, and we've never had a late delivery in over a year of working with them.
We ship palletized goods to retail chains across Luzon and Visayas. Roadquest handles everything — route planning, RoRo bookings, and last-mile delivery. Solid operation from start to finish.
The 24/7 dispatch is what sold us. Whenever we have urgent shipments, their team responds within minutes. Customer service that matches their on-road performance.

Moving construction materials from Manila to Davao used to be our biggest logistics headache. Roadquest's trailer fleet handles it smoothly and their tracking gives us full visibility throughout transit.
We've been using Roadquest for our nationwide distribution for months. Their closed vans keep our goods protected from weather, and the drivers are always courteous and careful with the cargo.
Excellent value for money. We compared several trucking companies and Roadquest came out on top for both pricing and reliability. They've become an essential part of our supply chain.
Their team genuinely cares about every shipment. When one of our deliveries got delayed by weather, they proactively rerouted and kept us informed. That level of communication is rare.
Roadquest's container hauling service is top-notch. They coordinate directly with the port and handle all the documentation, which saves our team hours of back-and-forth every shipment.
Safe, on-time, and professional. As a distributor serving multiple provinces, Roadquest has simplified our logistics and given us confidence that our cargo is in good hands every single trip.
